versions.content: If the swCalibrationAccess of a VariableDataPrototype used in an NvDataInterface of a non volatile data port of a SwComponentPro- totype is set to readOnly or readWrite and RteMeasurementSupport is set to true the RTE Generator shall create a McDataInstance element with • symbol set to the C-symbol name used for the allocation (see also [SWS_Rte_07197]) • flatMapEntry referencing to the corresponding FlatInstanceDescriptor element of the VariableDataPrototype
